status: same-author operator design and proof debugging; novelty and independent review open
inputs: public DAG G, deletable base edges A, budget h, known persistent edges K, independent unknown candidates L, authorized frozen singleton-membership source; true additions are K union V for arbitrary V subset L
native_target: full reachability after every subset of A of size at most h; additions persist
operator: Topologically rank G union K union L. Scan K union L once in increasing rank span. Test support against G plus the retained prefix using bounded maxflow. Redundant candidates are omitted with a flow certificate. Necessary known edges are retained; necessary unknown edges are queried and retained iff present. Return the physical least representation directly, without a second compilation or source-world enumeration.
working_theorem: For every compatible true state B, the full-permission full-budget query set equals {e in L: native_behavior(B) differs from native_behavior(B symmetric_difference {e})}. Every exact singleton-query policy valid on the full cube must query this set on B. Thus the operator is pointwise query-optimal, independent of prior and for any positive edge query costs. This is a proposed derived result to be debugged, not a novelty claim.
bounded_feasibility: Under an available subset of L and query cap b, exact completion occurs iff the full-run necessary query set is available and has size at most b. Unresolved states carry a necessary unqueried coordinate.
proof_objects: Redundancy: h+1 unit source-to-target paths, sharing nondeletable edges but no deletable edge. Necessity: a source-side partition whose crossing edges all belong to A and number at most h. A checker validates paths or partition without running maxflow or enumerating native outcomes.
residual_transport: For a redundant-edge certificate and one legal base deletion, remove its sole path containing that edge, or one arbitrary path if none contains it. The h remaining paths certify the residual h-1 budget against the same persistent support prefix. This does not establish free canonical coarsening or transport after arbitrary support/version changes.
exhaustive_audit: For n=2,3,4, enumerate every ordered edge as absent, protected base, deletable base, known persistent, or unknown persistent; every h from 0 to |A| and every subset of unknown edges. Independent bitset failure replay checks output, least subset and exact sensitive-coordinate query set. Stream a deterministic case digest rather than store the whole world bank.
old_fixture_control: All five unchanged adaptive_source_compile_v1.json fixtures, all 138 worlds, old-source fibers and declared four permission patterns/all budgets. Full runs retain detailed certificate receipts and compare against frozen common-arena source counts and physical outputs.
label_invariance: Re-run all 138 full-budget old worlds after reversing all vertex labels; query sets and stored edges must map exactly under the relabeling.
boundary_attacks: partial observation can have zero single-coordinate sensitivity but require a nonempty certificate
cycles can have the same gap even with full reachability
corrupted support and cut certificates rejected
costs: Charge one bounded-flow request per scanned known/unknown component, augmentations, membership calls, retained edge records and serialized receipts/certificates. Shared metadata and initial old encoding remain separate; no total-time or intrinsic-computation advantage claim.
freeze: Constructor, theorem target, exhaustive scope, all old fixtures, boundaries and metrics fixed before first execution. Any bug correction is logged. No sealed 512-unit reads or paid model calls. No result-driven new query policy tuning.
